title: Mobility Edge for the Anderson Model on Random Regular Graphs
summary: We determine the phase diagram of the Anderson tight-binding model on random regular graphs with Gaussian disorder and sufficiently large degree. In particular, we prove that if the degree is fixed and the number of vertices goes to infinity, the spectrum asymptotically consists of a finite delocalized interval surrounded by two unbounded localized components. Our argument uses a recent description of the spectrum of the tight-binding model on the Bethe lattice (Aggarwal--Lopatto, 2025).
